profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for solving problems and advancing the field of software development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Paycor Inc. is a large software company specializing in HR software targeted at small to mid-size companies. I joined the team tasked with modernizing the process of calculating and generating paychecks for the employees of our clients.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Cerebro Capital is a small startup--up with a PaaS offering that allows mid-market companies to find lenders to borrow money from. My role here was enhancing and modernizing their existing software written with .Net Framework and being modernized to .Net Core and React. 

In addition to development, I also led the Dev Ops initiatives at the company by migrating them from TFS to Git, setting up automated pipelines for deployment through their environments, and designing the implementation for all modernization efforts.
positions.insights: Azure DevOps Server, TypeScript and +5 skills

positions.title: Consultant II (Service Finance Company)
positions.description: Service Finance is a company that helps contractors provide homeowners with loans to fund their renovation projects. My team was tasked with building a new borrower portal to replace their old one. I served as the de facto architect and lead in this role when it came to the front-end and had a big hand in guiding decisions about the API.

positions.title: Consultant I (Ninety.IO)
positions.description: Ninety.IO is a SaaS company implementing the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) as software for companies to manage their goals and projects. I joined this team when it struggling to help get them back on track by building out their back-end API.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), TypeScript and +3 skills

positions.title: Associate Consultant (Hagerty Insurance)
positions.description: Hagerty Insurance agency is a large, well-established company that insures classic automobiles and boats. This was my first engagement out of college, and I worked across many of their projects to implement features for their underwriting team. This mostly surrounded the enhancement and revamp of their Straight Through Processing logic that allows prospective clients who are applying for coverage to automatically be accessed and issue a policy.
positions.insights: ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NEW Webforms and +2 skills
